_: Human pack: the adult female nipple-areola complex (NAC) as a skin feature for engine/tools/skin_feature.py. Every quality is a named parameter with its source and confidence. Lengths are RATIOS to the areola diameter D (or to the nipple diameter d) unless a unit is given, so a case supplies only the centre, the axis, D and a seed. Design: cases/woman2/NAC_DESIGN.md (orchestrator, 2026-10-19). Written by the woman2 Stage 4 builder, 2026-10-19.

sources.CLOSEUP: the person's reference cases/woman2/blueprints/nipple_closeup_side.jpg (AI-made side close-up, given as 'not perfect, but it gives a good idea'); measured in cases/woman2/stage4/closeup_measure.py -> checks/closeup_measure.json and by picking on 4x zooms (work/nipple_zoom.png, work/farnipple_zoom.png)
sources.SIDEBP: the person's side blueprints side_left.jpg / side_right.jpg: the far nipple in profile (4x zoom, work/side_nipples_zoom.png)
sources.APS1999: Aesthetic Plast Surg 1999, doi 10.1007/s002669900146: nipple / areola diameter 0.28 (abstract and search summary only)
sources.SANUKI2009: Sanuki J et al. 2009, Aesthetic Plast Surg, doi 10.1007/s00266-008-9194-y: nipple / areola diameter 0.325 (abstract and search summary only)
sources.DESIGN: cases/woman2/NAC_DESIGN.md ranges (orchestrator's design from anatomy texts; not a measurement)
sources.PERSON: the person, FINISH_SPEC F2: 'The areola sits nearly flush with the breast, with only a slight rise'; 2026-10-19: 'Nipples are the right size'
sources.EST: builder's estimate (no measurement); a value to be checked by the person's look

rise_mm.source: PERSON (nearly flush, slight rise); DESIGN 1-3 mm

margin_in.unit: r/R where the mound starts to fall
margin_in.source: EST from CLOSEUP (soft margin, the half-level edge at R)

margin_out.unit: r/R where the mound and the zone end

edge_width_mm.source: Stage 4b brief: a defined edge, a soft transition of about 1-2 mm (CLOSEUP shows a defined edge)

count.unit: sampled; those not wholly inside the areola's own irregular edge are dropped (about 13 kept)

ring_r_over_R.source: Stage 4b: inside the areola near its edge; DESIGN

ring_weight.unit: acceptance at the inner edge of the ring (1 = uniform)

lighten.unit: share of the areola pigment removed on a tubercle (toward the skin tone)

ring_wavelength_mm.source: CLOSEUP: concentric wrinkles 3-4 px apart at 6.1 px/mm

ring_amp_mm.source: EST, tuned on the clay look against CLOSEUP (0.035 read as a fingerprint)

ring_wander_mm.unit: wavelength of the noise that bends and breaks the rings

diameter_over_areola.source: CLOSEUP 58.5 px / 184 px (vertical, unforeshortened); APS1999 0.28, SANUKI2009 0.325
diameter_over_areola.confidence: measured (one image), inside the cited range

projection_over_diameter.source: CLOSEUP far nipple profile silhouette, re-measured on a sub-pixel outline (Stage 4b): projection 18.1 px over its half-height width 51 px (checks/far_nipple_profile.json); SIDEBP ~0.31
projection_over_diameter.confidence: measured (one image, as seen; not corrected for its view angle)

cap_height_over_projection.source: CLOSEUP: a short cylindrical body under a rounded cap (0.75 read as a smooth dome in the first look)

corrugation_wavelength_mm.source: CLOSEUP: fine fissures wrapping the nipple

corrugation_depth_mm.source: Stage 4b: an order of magnitude finer than 0.06 (read as a cobblestone top beside CLOSEUP)

texture_wavelength_mm.source: CLOSEUP: pebbly surface of the nipple

texture_amp_mm.source: Stage 4b: an order of magnitude finer

profile.unit: [rho / nipple radius, height / projection] from the tip to the foot
profile.source: CLOSEUP profile silhouette: the cap (rho <= 0.92) and the half-height width as measured; the body side made near-vertical and the base flare narrowed from the image blur (estimate): a rounded cap on a roughly cylindrical body

fine_noise_factor.unit: the micro noise amplitude on the nipple, relative to the areola

resolution_mm.note: edge lengths: glands 0.6 mm across get 6+ vertices, ring wrinkles 5+ per wavelength; duct openings near 2-3 vertices across (half shading)

contracted._: stored for the later response layer (cold, touch): the areolar smooth muscle contracts - a smaller, wrinkled, slightly raised areola and an erect nipple. Multipliers on the relaxed values unless a value is given. All estimates (physiology texts describe it; no measurement here).

pigment._: The areola's radial pigment profile from CLOSEUP, de-lit: the redness (Lab a*) median along 16 rays in the areola's own frame (horizontal radius rescaled by the foreshortening), normalised between the areola body (r/R 0.35-0.55) and the skin just outside (1.2-1.4), 3-bin smoothed (a* is nearly free of the shading that scales lightness; the de-lit luminance ratios, kept in checks/closeup_measure.json, carried shading residue and put the edge at 0.8 R). strength 1 = the areola's own pigment, 0 = skin. The papilla takes the nipple pigment. The LEVELS (areola and nipple colour as ratios to the skin) are the case's own photo (case file), the SHAPE is this profile.

angular_amp_applied.source: EST (natural irregularity; the measured ray-to-ray spread is mostly shading)

nipple_redder.value: the case photo's nipple ratio (more red than the areola relative to G and B)
nipple_redder.source: the case photo; DESIGN ('a little redder: more blood supply')

pigment.edge: Stage 4b: strength = the close-up redness gradient inside (normalised to 1 at 0.85 R, clipped 0.9-1.3) times a defined edge: 1 - smoothstep over edge_width_mm centred at R (the half-level radius); the redness profile alone faded over the outer 40 % (a wide halo)

roughness.source: Stage 4b: no glossier than the skin on the areola, so the small bumps do not sparkle; the nipple slightly glossier (sebum); EST

subsurface_scale_factor.source: DESIGN ('a fattier breast scatters more'); values EST

pores.source: DESIGN ('sparser and smaller than on the back'); EST

veins._: superficial veins under the thin breast skin: branching paths from the breast's periphery toward the periareolar plexus (estimate of the usual pattern), shown as a subtle subsurface tint fading with depth

tint_rgb_factor.unit: multiplier at full strength (bluish under thin skin)

regional_tone._: the breast is often paler than the chest and arms (less sun). Measured per case from its photo, de-lit (case file); applied as a low-frequency factor over the breast zone.
